profile.role.value: Product manager who ships software but does not write it.

profile.experience.value: Has never programmed. Assume no computing background at all.

preference.style.value: Terse and plain. Explain the idea in everyday words, with an analogy if one helps.

preference.format.value: Short prose, at most four sentences. No headings, no bullet lists.

rule.no-code.value: Never show code, command lines, config or pseudocode. Not even one line.

rule.no-jargon.value: Never use an unexplained technical term. Say the plain word instead.
